### Create a new FAQ inside knowledge base
POST /knowledge-bases/faqs
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/knowledge-bases/faqs
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/create | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/create.md

Creates a new question-and-answer entry in a knowledge base.
WHEN TO USE: use this when you need to add a brand-new FAQ; use update to change an existing one; use list to see current FAQs.
RETURNS: success and the created FAQ, including its server-assigned id.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: knowledge-bases.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) AddFaqDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HqDZpF8GH3qvgJTmKCoL") - location ID as string
- question* string (e.g. "What is the capital of France?") - faq question as a string
- answer* string (e.g. "The capital of France is Paris.") - faq answer as a string
- knowledgeBaseId* string (e.g. "710KoEzy793Fxubft0bc") - knowledge base ID as string

Response 201 (FAQ created successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success status of the operation
- faq* object - Created FAQ details
  - id* string - FAQ ID as string
  - question* string - FAQ question
  - questionLowerCase* string - FAQ question in lowercase
  - answer* string - FAQ answer
  - knowledgeBaseId* string - Knowledge base ID
  - locationId* string - Location ID
  - trainedUrlId* string - Trained URL ID
  - deleted* boolean - Whether the FAQ is deleted
  - createdAt* string - Date when FAQ was created
  - updatedAt* string - Date when FAQ was last updated

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 500 (Internal Server Error) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code
- message string - Error message

### Start crawling and discover pages for training
POST /knowledge-bases/crawler
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/knowledge-bases/crawler
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/discover-website | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/discover-website.md

Starts a website crawl that discovers pages for later AI training.
WHEN TO USE: use this when you need to scan a site before training; use trainDiscoveredUrls to ingest selected pages; use getCrawlingStatusForLatestOperation to poll progress.
RETURNS: the discovery operation id, current status, and the URL being crawled.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: knowledge-bases.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) DiscoverWebsiteRequestDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Location ID as string
- url* string (e.g. "https://kubernetes.io/tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Website URL as string
- option* string (enum: Exact | Path | Domain; e.g. "Exact") - Mode as string
- knowledgeBaseId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - knowledge base ID as string
- preSelectedUrls string[] (e.g. ["https://example.com/page-1","https://example.com/page-2"]) - Pre-selected URLs from sitemap preview — when provided, only these URLs are crawled
- autoTrain boolean - Automatically train the discovered URLs after crawling

Response 201 (Crawling and discovery started successfully) application/json:
- operationId* string - Operation ID for tracking the discovery process
- status* string (enum: Pending | Processing | Successful | Failed | Existing | Restricted | Cancelled | Aborted | Training; read-only) - Current status of the website discovery operation
- url* string - The URL being discovered/crawled

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 500 (Internal Server Error) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code
- message string - Error message

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 500 (Internal Server Error) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code
- message string - Error message

### Get all knowledge bases for a location by location Id (paginated)
GET /knowledge-bases/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/knowledge-bases/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/list-all-knowledge-bases-paginated | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/list-all-knowledge-bases-paginated.md

Lists knowledge bases for a sub-account (location), with optional name search and cursor pagination.
WHEN TO USE: use this when you need to see which knowledge bases exist; use getKnowledgeBaseById for one; use createKnowledgeBase to add one.
RETURNS: a page of knowledge bases, activeCount, hasMore, and lastKnowledgeBaseId for the next page.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: knowledge-bases.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "qIyivCmsuEOSnyoFYEej") - The location ID to retrieve knowledge bases for
- query string (e.g. "bot training") - search query for knowledge base name
- limit number (default: 20) - Maximum number of knowledge bases to return
- lastKnowledgeBaseId string (e.g. "ZwTB8S0yo0FIBY6OPZTD") - ID of the last knowledge base from the previous page (for pagination)

Response 200 (Paginated knowledge bases retrieved successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success status of the operation
- data* object - Paginated knowledge bases data
  - knowledgeBases* object[] - Array of knowledge bases
    - id* string - Knowledge base ID
    - name* string - Knowledge base name
    - createdAt* string - Date when knowledge base was created
    - updatedAt string - Date when knowledge base was last updated
  - activeCount* number - Total count of all active knowledge bases
  - hasMore* boolean - Whether there are more knowledge bases available
  - lastKnowledgeBaseId string - ID of the last knowledge base in this page (use for next page request)

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

- operationId* string (e.g. "689267ba9d8d63ea160ee9c7") - Operation ID as string
- urlIds* string[] (e.g. ["689267ccb27254d92da17b69"]) - List of URL IDs to train

### Uploads a file to knowledge base (max file size: 10MB)
POST /knowledge-bases/files
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/knowledge-bases/files
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/upload-file | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/knowledge-base/upload-file.md

Uploads a PDF, DOC, or DOCX file (max 10MB) into a knowledge base for training.
WHEN TO USE: use this when you need to add a document source; use getFilesByKnowledgeBasePublic to list uploads; use deleteFile to remove a file. Do not use this for website pages — use discoverWebsite / trainDiscoveredUrls.
RETURNS: success and the uploaded file url, fileId, and folder path.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: knowledge-bases.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (multipart/form-data) KnowledgeBaseFileUploadRequestDTO:
File upload with metadata
- locationId string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - location id
- knowledgeBaseId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - knowledge base id
- file* file - File to upload (max size: 10MB). Supported formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX

Response 200 (Uploads a file to knowledge base) application/json:
- success* boolean - success
- data* object - details of the uploaded file
  - url* string - url of the uploaded file
  - fileId* string - file id of the uploaded file
  - folderPath* string - folder path of the uploaded file

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 500 (Internal Server Error) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code
- message string - Error message
